# Covault

> A fully-collateralized, cash-settled European options clearinghouse on Stacks,
> settled in sBTC or native STX. Every payoff is capped at its locked collateral,
> so the system is solvent by construction: no liquidations, no margin, no funding.

Covault is testnet software. Nothing here is investment advice.

The core invariant, which the whole product is built around:
`payoff + leftover = collateral` — a writer's maximum loss is exactly the
collateral they lock, and the holder's maximum gain can never exceed it.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://covault-testnet.vercel.app/docs): what Covault is and the solvency argument
- [Quickstart](https://covault-testnet.vercel.app/docs/quickstart): write or buy a first option
- [Lifecycle](https://covault-testnet.vercel.app/docs/lifecycle): create, write, trade, settle, claim
- [Settlement](https://covault-testnet.vercel.app/docs/settlement): oracle price source, freshness checks, fallbacks
- [Fees](https://covault-testnet.vercel.app/docs/fees): protocol fee model
- [Contract](https://covault-testnet.vercel.app/docs/contract): public functions and read-only entry points
- [Error codes](https://covault-testnet.vercel.app/docs/errors): every contract error and what triggers it
